summary: Configured persistent POSIX ACL inheritance on node1. Designer-created files and directories remain designer-owned, reviewer receives inherited read/write access, and visitor is denied access. Existing project data was preserved, and behavior survived a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Installed the signed RHEL acl package; the OS release and kernel remained unchanged.
Created local accounts designer, reviewer, and visitor.
Added access and default ACLs to /srv/legacy2/inherited-directory-acls/projects without a periodic repair job.
Tested inheritance using the named identities, including reviewer writes and visitor denials.
Removed test artifacts and confirmed brief.txt retained its original checksum and metadata.
Restarted node1 safely and repeated health, persistence, and identity-based access tests.

evidence.summary: designer, reviewer, and visitor resolve as persistent local accounts before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Automatic inherited access with designer ownership
evidence.summary: Default ACLs grant designer and reviewer rwx. Designer-created directories and documents remained owned by designer; reviewer successfully read and appended both before and after restart.
Actual visitor read, write, directory traversal, and parent creation attempts were denied.
brief.txt retained checksum 5c077cd26fc7d84d4c43e9b5dfa674428ab1ce50c38422e63678d35043f43082 and original root:root ownership, mode 0644, size 50, and timestamp. Test artifacts were removed.
No cron file or systemd unit referencing the project path or an ACL/permission repair job was found; inheritance is filesystem-native.

evidence.requirement: Compatible software while retaining OS and kernel
evidence.summary: Native signed RHEL acl 2.4.0 package was installed. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged through restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID a3e8d9cc-3426-483b-bee1-33f061401189; reboot was safely scheduled and acknowledged; the new boot ID was 31f202f8-d2ea-4648-82e8-087c7c185faf. SSH, accounts, ACLs, protected data, and access behavior recovered with no failed units.
